description:

Topics can include choosing fixtures, planning plumbing layouts, selecting bathroom furniture, improving water efficiency, understanding installation requirements, avoiding common renovation mistakes, and creating a bathroom that balances visual appeal with everyday practicality.

A recurring theme throughout the series is that good bathroom design requires more than choosing attractive products. Materials, measurements, plumbing clearances, sink placement, storage, finishes, and long-term maintenance all need to work together. For example, homeowners researching Vanity Tops can benefit from understanding how countertop material, dimensions, sink configuration, edge design, and the surrounding vanity affect the finished bathroom.

The podcast will provide straightforward explanations without unnecessary technical jargon, helping listeners understand what to consider before making decisions or beginning a renovation. Episodes can feature practical scenarios, design discussions, renovation checklists, and conversations with professionals from the plumbing, bathroom, construction, and interior-design industries.

author: Alison Booth
description:
Stroud, in Gloucestershire, is a small market town which sits on the edge of the Cotswolds and at the heart of five valleys. Surrounded by hills, the town also boasts historical canals, secluded rivers, picturesque mill ponds and tranquil nature reserves. No surprise then that Stroud has become a hub for people with a passion for nature and the environment. And from canal restoration to organic farming co-operatives, Stroud’s nature lovers can get their hands dirty with a range of different local groups. One such group is Stroud Valleys Project (SVP), an environmental charity with projects throughout the area, including allotments, wetlands, gardens, canals, rivers…. projects powered by local volunteers of all ages, all backgrounds and all abilities.


In Stroud’s Wild Valleys former BBC Radio producer-turned conservation volunteer Al Booth explores some of the hidden, and not so hidden, wildlife havens in this beautiful part of the world. Accompanied by SVP project leaders and volunteers she experiences first-hand how people and nature can thrive together.


www.stroudvalleysproject.org

title: You Are Not Your Scars
author: Ellie Shefi
description:
Are you sick and tired of being held back by the chains of your past? Of others dictating your life … telling you what to say, how to act, and even how to feel?


Are you searching for a way to silence the inner critic, breakthrough limiting beliefs, and come "home" to your true, authentic self? A way to find your voice and speak your truth? A way to laugh, love, and play again?


Are you ready to step into a future you design? 


If you're looking for actionable tools and strategies to take back your power and create a life you love, then you're in the right place!


I've done it again and again.

And so have my guests.


I'm Ellie Shefi. I am a survivor of rape and domestic abuse. I've been homeless, lived in my car, and eaten the food restaurants were throwing away at the end of the night. I'm a cancer survivor and medical miracle who has been defying the doctors' death deadlines for decades. I've endured countless medical surgeries—often with little hope of survival. At my breaking point, I even begged God to just let me die. (Now that is hitting rock bottom!)


Yet, today, I am a limitless thriver. I am a successful attorney, entrepreneur, #1 international best-selling and award-winning author, sought-after international speaker, strategist, media host, publisher, philanthropist, mentor, coach, and consultant. I have mastered turning fear into fuel, and pain into purpose, and now I am blessed to live joyful life I love.


You see … Like so many of us, I, too, have scars—emotional, mental, and physical. But throughout my journey, I have learned that I am not my scars! I have healed and moved beyond the scars and the wounds and burdens that caused them. I have cast off the chains of the past and set myself free. I no longer allow my scars to hold me back…to deny me my personal path toward a life of authenticity and abundance.


I'm here to help you do the same.


If you're sick and tired of being defined by events, circumstances, and beliefs—if you're longing to shed past pain and rise beyond your adversities—if you're looking for post-traumatic growth—then this podcast, You Are Not Your Scars, is for you!


On this podcast, my guests and I show you how to shed your scars, claim your internal freedom, and create a life you love. We equip you with the tools and strategies you need to find your voice, stand in your power, and become the architect of your life. We guide you in charting a new course for your journey, help you build a resilient mind, and help you develop your unique, authentic, and aligned soul signature that no one can imitate or destroy.


Joining me every episode are masters of resiliency, mindset, personal development, overcoming trauma, and more! They are here to offer you the tools, resources, and strategies you need to break free from the past, claim your future, and create a life you love.


No matter how deep your wounds are, you are resilient. You are unbreakable. And you are unstoppable. You have control over your life!


Live life on your terms today.

While you may have been forged from the fire, you are free by design.


Remember: You Are Not Your Scars!


Catch up on episodes at youarenotyourscarspodcast.com.

title: Tempest

description:
Tempest tells the true stories of the world's great storms and the science of how weather works. Each episode, host Nirob takes one storm — a hurricane that erased a city that thought it could not happen, a river that turned into an inland sea, an outbreak of tornadoes that crossed a continent in a night, a cyclone that split a nation in two — and rebuilds it: the weather that made it possible, the warnings that were or were not heard, the storm as it actually unfolded, the wake it left, and the forecasting and engineering that came out of the disaster.
From the great Caribbean hurricane of 1780 to the Galveston storm of 1900, from the Mississippi floods and the Central China floods to the Bhola cyclone of 1970, from Hurricane Camille to the Super Outbreak, from Katrina to Typhoon Haiyan, Tempest is about the most powerful and least predictable force in the natural world — and about how human beings learned, slowly and often at terrible cost, to read the sky. Meticulously researched, honest about what is known and what is still unknowable, and clear about the difference between the record and the legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. We're talking about the things that hurt, the patterns we don't always understand, the people who changed us, the parts of ourselves we're still trying to rebuild, and the messy process of figuring out who the hell we are afterward.
It won't always be pretty.
It won't always be serious.
And it definitely won't always be politically correct.
There will be hard conversations, uncomfortable truths, dark humor, probably too much swearing, and plenty of moments where we ask, “What the actual fuck?”
Because healing doesn't have to look perfect.
Sometimes it looks like crying.
Sometimes it looks like setting boundaries.
Sometimes it looks like starting over.
And sometimes it looks like laughing at the absolute absurdity of your own life.
This isn't a podcast about having all the answers.

In the summer of 2021, I suffered a stroke.


The five years since have been a journey of recovery and rehabilitation, of finding bits of myself again while also forging a new identity.


One question people often ask me is how I have managed to stay positive through all of this. I created Return to Myselfpartly to answer that question—and to give other stroke survivors and caregivers a glimpse into what that journey has actually looked like. The way back to myself has not always been easy.

These are reflections on recovery, creativity, relationships, setbacks, small victories, and the unexpected ways in which a life can take shape again.

title: Long Time Dead
author: Ash Hawrani
description:
Long Time Dead is an exploration of death as the inevitability that transcends culture, religion, wealth, status, and social position. Hosted by Ash Hawrani, the podcast asks us to confront a subject that is simultaneously universal and strangely difficult to discuss.

Each episode interrogates death from both an ontological and epistemological perspective: What is death? What is its nature? What can we actually know about it? And what meanings, rituals, fears, and symbols do human beings create in response to it?

The show begins by looking at how different people and cultures reckon with mortality. Through conversations with individuals from different faith traditions, we explore questions such as: What do you believe death is? Do you think about it often? How do you reconcile yourself with it? And do you fear it? 

These conversations examine the striking differences and unexpected similarities in how human beings confront the same inevitable end.

From there, the podcast moves into philosophy and psychoanalysis, exploring thinkers such as Plato, Freud, Lacan, and Žižek and their attempts to understand the relationship between life, death, desire, and consciousness. Freud's concept of the death drive, Plato's reflections on mortality, and the tension between carpe diem and memento mori become starting points for a larger question: Can life be understood without death?

The podcast also looks beyond formal philosophy. Cultural rituals surrounding the dead, changing attitudes toward mourning, popular representations such as the Grim Reaper, and the reflections of figures such as comedian Norm Macdonald all become evidence in a larger investigation into how human beings give form and meaning to mortality.

Long Time Dead is an ongoing conversation about the thing none of us can ultimately avoid and the possibility that confronting it might tell us more about life than death itself.

Subscribe and join the conversation.

In the pages of the "The Swedish Fairy Book," magical creatures come alive as Klara Stroebe uncovers the enchanting tales of Scandinavian folklore. This captivating collection features 28 distinct stories, each brimming with the vibrant essence of Swedish culture. Meet wise trolls, adventurous princesses, and cunning foxes as they navigate challenges that test their bravery and wit. Each tale not only entertains but also imparts timeless lessons about friendship, perseverance, and the power of kindness.

From the bustling marketplaces to the quiet forests of Sweden, these stories draw young listeners into a world where imagination reigns supreme. Whether it’s the clever tricks of a mischievous sprite or the heartfelt journey of a lost hero, each narrative is infused with a colorful charm that invites children to dream and explore.

As you listen, you'll discover why these tales were selected for their unique flavor and appeal, making them perfect for family storytelling or bedtime snuggles. Klara Stroebe's work captures the heart of Swedish tradition, bringing forth a treasure trove of folklore that resonates with listeners of all ages. Dive into the magic of the "Swedish Fairy Book" and join the adventure—where every chapter promises a new discovery and a sprinkle of wonder.

title: My Library. My Life.
author: Jewish Public Library
description:
What can a library tell us about who we are?
On My Library. My Life., host Tommy Schnurmacher sits down with authors, academics, artists, innovators, and community leaders to explore the ideas, stories, and conversations that shape Jewish life today.
From literature and comedy to ethics, history, identity, and cultures from around the world, each episode leads somewhere unexpected.
My Library. My Life. is a podcast created by the Jewish Public Library of Montreal.

title: Point of View
author: Stevens Point Area Public Schools
description:
Point of View is the Stevens Point Area Public School District podcast, featuring conversations with students, staff and community members about the people, experiences and ideas shaping our schools.
Each episode offers a closer look at what’s happening across SPAPSD, from student perspectives and classroom experiences to programs, opportunities and the work happening behind the scenes.
Our goal is simple. Share more of the voices that make up our schools and give listeners another way to connect with our district.

author: Karissa Johnson
description: A solo podcast for founder-CEOs at the growth stage. Hosted by Karissa Johnson, brand strategist and founder of Setpoint Strategy. Each episode explores brand clarity, leadership, and the real experience of building, including anxiety, burnout, and the decisions that define who you become as a leader. If you want to lead with more intention and build a company that reflects who you actually are, this is the show.

author: Azhar SEO
description: Discover educational conversations about methylene blue, wellness routines, product quality, and the latest information around this unique compound. Explore practical insights from Earthia covering methylene blue basics, liquid supplements, responsible use, and how to make informed decisions about your wellness routine.

title: Six Degrees of Bacon and Eggs
author: reneemcardlej
description: I’m Renee McArdle wife, mother, friend and real estate agent. I live in Petaluma, a small town that was once known as the “egg capital of the world” where everyone feels connected only by a couple of degrees (hence the 6 degrees of Kevin Bacon reference). I can ask anyone in town a couple of questions and it won’t take long for us to find a mutual friend, colleague, or a place that we are both connected to. I know so many interesting people in Petaluma who are doing really cool things, have interesting experiences to share, are deep rooted in Petaluma, can help others in our community or can share about their local businesses. I’m going to start each episode talking about how my life is connected to my guest. Listeners out there are going to find connections with my guests, their kids, people they know, places they spend time. I hope they will all play along…

title: In The Lion's Den
author: Glenn Bayly
description:
What does it mean to faithfully follow Jesus Christ in today's world?
In the Lion's Den explores that question through thoughtful conversations with Christian professors, educators, pastors, ministry leaders, and professionals. Hosted by Glenn Bayly, each episode examines the questions, challenges, and opportunities believers encounter in their homes, churches, schools, workplaces, and communities.
Inspired by the faith of Daniel, In the Lion's Den encourages listeners to stand firmly on God's Word while engaging today's culture with biblical wisdom, grace, humility, and courage.
Whether you're seeking a deeper understanding of Scripture, practical encouragement for everyday life, or thoughtful conversations about faith and culture, In the Lion's Den equips believers to live faithfully wherever God has called them.
Produced by The Awakening Worldwide, In the Lion's Den exists to encourage believers, strengthen Christ's Church, and equip Christians to pray faithfully, grow in God's Word, engage their communities, and partner in advancing the Gospel.

description: This is a Madera Unified School District podcast with Assistant Superintendent of Student & Family Support Services Prince Marshall and Director of Safety & Security Lawrence Fernandez.

title: HIRE Calling
author: Avetis Antaplyan & HIRECLOUT
description:
The biggest decisions shaping your career are often made behind closed doors. Who gets hired? Who gets promoted? Who gets laid off? Who keeps growing while others get left behind?

HIRE CALLING pulls back the curtain on how those decisions are really made. Hosted by Avetis Antaplyan, Founder and CEO of HIRECLOUT, the show brings you candid conversations with executives, hiring leaders, operators, and industry insiders alongside practical insights from decades inside the hiring market.

If you want to get hired, advance your career, lead better, and stay valuable as the world of work changes, HIRE CALLING gives you the perspective usually reserved for the other side of the table.

title: Retail on the Record
author: Automotive News
description: A weekly podcast hosted by Senior Editor Dan Shine featuring discussions with dealers and dealership leaders about what’s transpiring inside their stores, the decisions they’re making and the trends they’re seeing in automotive retail.

title: Broken Arrow Today!
author: Eric Thompson
description:
Broken Arrow Today! is your weekday update on what’s happening across Broken Arrow, Oklahoma. Hosted by Eric Thompson, each Monday through Friday episode keeps you connected to the local stories that matter—from community news and public safety to schools, sports, new businesses, local deals, restaurants, events, entertainment, and things to do around town.

We’ll talk about the people and businesses that make Broken Arrow home, highlight upcoming community events, share local stories you may have missed, and help you discover more of what our city has to offer. Whether you’ve lived in Broken Arrow for decades or just moved to town, Broken Arrow Today! gives you a quick, useful way to start your day informed and connected.

 Broken Arrow Today! — Know your city. Support local. Stay connected. Powered by BrokenArrow.App — Buy • Sell • Discover Local.

title: ReputaForge | Build Your Reputation
author: ReputaForge
description: ReputaForge helps brands earn respect, engage audiences, and rise above the noise. By combining data-driven insights with creative storytelling, we manage reputations that influence perception and drive growth. Our team supports clients through proactive brand building, reputation repair, and strategic communications—ensuring trust becomes a key business advantage.

title: The Empowered Midlife Podcast
author: Dr. Nic + Nat
description:
Hosted by twin sisters Dr. Nicole McCulloch, ND and Dr. Natalie Sandilands, ND, naturopathic doctors and Menopause Society Certified Practitioners, the Empowered Midlife Podcast is a space where women can learn what’s really happening in their bodies during perimenopause and menopause.


After years of working with women in clinical practice, Dr. Nic and Dr. Nat saw the same pattern again and again: women feeling overwhelmed by symptoms, dismissed by the healthcare system, and left trying to figure things out on their own.


This podcast was created to change that.


Each week, they break down the science behind midlife health and share practical strategies to help you navigate your 40s and 50s with more clarity and confidence. 


Through evidence-based guidance, real clinical insight, and sisterly conversation, they explore the symptoms and changes many women experience during this transition.

Topics include hormones, sleep, mood, metabolism, energy, brain fog, libido, and the daily habits that support long-term health.


Midlife isn’t the end of your health story. With the right tools and support, it can be one of the most vibrant and empowering chapters yet.

title: Who Told You ...You Were Done?
author: Dr. Joan Jones
description: Honest conversation on mental health, faith, travel, and your forgotten bucket list. This podcast is for everyone, but especially for those experiencing life after 60. You who have gone through a transition period such as retirement, divorce, or just aging transition.

author: GraceFirst Wichita
description: GraceFirst is an Evangelical Free church in Wichita, KS. We are committed to the great commission and the greatest commandment which boils down to this: Love God and Love People. We want to show Jesus' radical love to the world and make disciples who make disciples.

title: Live Sent: Taking it Past Sunday

description: A podcast from Gospel Grace Church that helps further study and application of Sunday's sermon to the week that follows.

title: Nirav Kadakia
author: Nirav Kadakia
description:
Professional Background Nirav Kadakia is a technology leader with more than 25 years of experience, currently serving as Head of DevOps at Access | Information Management. Before joining Access, he spent nearly 15 years at Vonage, advancing through progressively senior engineering roles, including Senior Engineer, Technical Manager, Infrastructure Architect, Director of Call Processing, and ultimately Senior Director of Engineering. He holds a Master of Science in Computational Biology/Bioinformatics and a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, both from New Jersey Institute of Technology, and has earned the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate credential. This combination of long-tenured engineering leadership and formal technical credentials underpins his current role guiding enterprise cloud and DevOps strategy.


Expertise & Focus Areas Nirav's technical focus centers on cloud-native and DevOps-centric transformation. He architects enterprise platforms that enable secure, scalable software delivery, applying expertise in cloud governance, security hardening, and cost optimization strategies that align technology investment with business objectives. He shares this expertise publicly through his technology blog, Musings of Nirav Kadakia, which covers real-world AWS architecture, Terraform, FinOps, and site reliability engineering, including a multi-part FinOps series on managing cost across 40+ AWS accounts. Taken together, his hands-on platform work and public writing reflect a practitioner who is actively engaged with current cloud and DevOps practice.


Leadership & Value Propositions As a leader, Nirav is defined by a data-driven, analytical approach to building and running technology teams. He has built and led high-performing teams that shifted organizational mindsets toward DevOps methodologies and cloud-first practices, while managing large-scale technology budgets and vendor relationships. He describes himself as an evangelist for enablement and continuous improvement, focused on giving development teams the tools, practices, and culture needed to deliver software safely, efficiently, and at scale. This leadership style, rooted in mentorship, relationship building, and clear goal-setting through KPIs, has been a consistent thread throughout his career.


Differentiators What sets Nirav apart is the pairing of deep technical invention with organizational leadership. He is credited as an inventor on at least 6 US patents in VoIP and telecommunications technology, including patented systems for improving VoIP call quality and for off-net SMS message routing, developed during his time at Vonage. This patent record reflects a strong technical foundation and an innovation mindset that he applies to solving complex infrastructure challenges, distinguishing him from leaders whose background is purely managerial.


Personal & Community Beyond his professional work, Nirav is active in his community and family life. In 2024, he ran for a seat on the Marlboro Board of Education as part of the Partners Improving Education (PIE) slate, alongside fellow candidates Brian Cohen and Jenna Corraro. His stated motivation was to bring proactive, data-driven leadership to the district and to help ensure every student, including his own two daughters, has access to a high-quality education. He has also coached youth basketball for a local Recreation Teams program for the past 5 years, winning two consecutive championships, an experience he says reflects the same commitment to teamwork and excellence that defines his approach to technology leadership. He is a devoted New York Yankees and New York Giants fan who spends much of his free time with his family.

title: What's The Commission?
author: Nick Terry
description: What's the Commission is a light-hearted look at commercial real estate, hosted by Nick Terry and Landon Coker: brokers, investors, and business owners. We break down what's happening in our day-to-day, dig into deals and industry trends, and run regular segments like 'the dumbest thing we heard in real estate this week' — equal parts insight and entertainment for anyone in CRE, investing, sales or business.

title: Dying On Tuesday
author: Bill Keenan
description:
For John Borden, dying is the least of his worries.


It’s 1989 and John is an unscrupulous waterbed salesman sleeping through life, until he meets Claire, a beautiful psychic, at a tarot party. She draws seven cards and predicts John will suffer seven absurd events over the next seven days, culminating with a death sentence: he will die on the seventh day. But John doesn’t believe in this “psychic stuff.”


That is, until Claire’s predictions start coming true with eerie precision, forcing John to face some hard questions. Can you cheat your fate? Are there worse things than death?

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: My path, plans, actions and solutions
author: Jack Rap
description: In this audio, I talk about my path, plans, actions and solutions. I use zero, first and second conditional. I also talk about leadership, responsibility and adaptability.

title: Smart Water Box – Turn Air Into Water |
author: Harsh Yadav
description: Smart Water Box is an innovative water-from-air solution designed to extract moisture from the air and convert it into usable water. Explore how Smart Water Box works, its technology, benefits, and potential applications for sustainable water generation.

title: Fostered in Unity
author: Fostered in Unity
description:
Fostered in Unity is a podcast about bringing the Church together to care for vulnerable children and families. Through honest stories, meaningful conversations, and practical resources, we explore the many ways God is working through foster care, adoption, churches, nonprofits, and communities—and help you discover your piece of the puzzle.
Whether you’re already serving or simply wondering where you fit, our hope is to equip, encourage, and mobilize the body of Christ to step into this work together.

title: Quanversations
author: Ju’Quan Stewart
description: Quanversations is where faith, life, culture, and real conversation meet. Hosted by Dr. Ju’Quan L. Stewart, each episode explores the questions, challenges, relationships, and everyday experiences that shape who we are and who we’re becoming. From spiritual growth to difficult people and everything in between, nothing is off the table. Come ready to think, laugh, grow, and have a real Quanversation.

title: Care CEOs Unfiltered
author: Tasha McCray
description: Two nurses & healthcare business owners with 64+ years of combined experience saying the things nobody says out loud about running a care business. Adult day care, group homes, independent living, home care, non-emergency medical transportation: if you own it and it's running you, this channel is for you.  We talk compliance, staffing, money, burnout, and the advice floating around this industry that quietly doesn't work. Light, fun, occasionally petty, always useful.  New episodes weekly. Hosted by Dr. Tasha and Dr. Catrina.  Real conversations. Real leaders. Real impact.

title: Committed to Cattle Health
author: Sarah Muirhead
description:
Are you passionate about raising healthy, thriving cattle? Do you want to stay ahead of the latest breakthroughs in animal health? Then this is the podcast for you.

"Committed to Cattle Health" is your essential resource for cutting-edge insights, expert advice, and practical strategies to optimize the health and performance of your herd. Each episode delivers actionable knowledge on disease prevention, nutrition management, welfare practices, and the latest innovations in cattle care.


"Committed to Cattle Health" is brought to you by Elanco Animal Health.

title: Health Cascades
author: UW School of Public Health
description: How is our health decided? Is it our personal choices, or larger forces like air quality, loneliness, disasters, workplaces, and stress? On Health Cascades, the University of Washington School of Public Health explores the cascading causes shaping our health and how we can change them. Go behind the scenes with the researchers, professionals, and people who are working to make their communities healthier for everyone.

title: Unquiet Lantern: Dark Stories
author: Unquiet Lantern
description:
Dark stories from around the world.

Cinematic audio adaptations of classic literature, folklore and forgotten tales — brought to life through immersive narration, music and sound.

Gothic horror, supernatural fiction, mystery and strange stories from across cultures. 

New stories from Unquiet Lantern.

title: “Choosing the Best Toys for Kids: A Pare
author: Harrison343
description: Choosing the right toy for a child can sometimes be difficult, especially with so many different options available. In this episode, we talk about a few simple things parents can consider when choosing toys, including a child’s age, interests, creativity, and the type of play they enjoy. From building sets and puzzles to arts and crafts, games, action figures and sensory toys, there are plenty of ways to make playtime both fun and engaging. title: Monday Conversation

description: Each Monday, PYMNTS CEO Karen Webster sits down with executives and visionaries across the payments and commerce industries to talk about what’s trending now. From hot-button issues to headline-making innovation, these one-on-one conversations offer a front-row seat to the ideas and people shaping what’s next.

title: The Good Investor
author: Robin C. John
description:
This is a show about faith, business, sports, and investing. 

Through conversations with athletes, business leaders, theologians, and cultural voices, hosts Chris Broussard and Robin John examine what it means to build, lead, and invest with purpose—and what good business and good investing are really all about.

Robin John immigrated from South India to Boston at 8 years old and became the Co-Founder and CEO of the faith-based investing firm Eventide. Chris Broussard is a sports analyst and commentator who founded the K.I.N.G movement. 

Somehow, they ended up co-hosting a podcast about faith, investing, and basketball. The result is a series of conversations with guests you know—discussing topics you likely won't hear them explore anywhere else.

title: All Things Youth by Generations Podcast
author: Generations Church
description:
All Things Youth: Conversations for Our Next Generation

For anyone invested in the next generation.

All Things Youth is a podcast by Christian youth ministry leaders, creating space for honest conversations, and support for those guiding and caring for today’s youth as we navigate a rapidly changing world. Together, we explore the challenges our youth face, the realities ministry doesn’t always prepare us for, and what we’re learning along the way.

title: The Inspiring Real Life

description:
What if the lessons that could transform your life are hiding in stories you’ve never heard? 
Welcome to The YE Show with Youness El Fehdi—where inspiring guests share real experiences, unexpected lessons, and insights on resilience, leadership, purpose, personal growth, communication, health, and language mastery.

description:
Real founder stories from the trenches. Join me, James Summers, as I host entrepreneurs who made the pivotal turns, faced near-failures, and unlocked key insights that propelled them from startup to scale-up. Unfiltered, practical, and built for founders who want to build smarter. Because the best lessons come from those who’ve already driven the road ahead.
To begin a growth journey with James drive to https://bloomcoach.uk/

author: The Legal Podcast Network (LPN)
description: Legall Answers: Property and Probate is a podcast dedicated to providing clear and practical legal guidance on probate, estate disputes, and landlord matters. Hosted by Evan Mack, the show features expert insights from Attorney Sharon Legall, who brings over a decade of experience in helping families and property owners navigate complex legal processes. Whether you're dealing with the loss of a loved one or managing property issues, this podcast offers valuable information to help you make informed decisions. Listeners can expect straightforward advice and actionable steps to handle their legal challenges effectively.

title: Truth Reclaimed
author: Truth Reclaimed
description: Truth Reclaimed is a podcast that breaks down human behavior with clarity, emotional intelligence, and spiritual grounding. Each episode takes real‑life situations — the subtle moments, the hidden motives, the unspoken energy — and decodes what’s actually happening beneath the surface.

title: SYSTEM Stress Test
author: SYSTEM Jiu-Jitsu
description:
Ideas are easy. Resistance tells the truth.
SYSTEM Stress Test is Nick Kugelman and Jacen Flynn, Jiu-Jitsu black belts, competitors, fathers, coaches, and owners of SYSTEM JIU-JITSU in Meridian, Idaho.
Each week, we take the accepted wisdom of jiu-jitsu, competition, coaching, business, fatherhood, and personal growth and put it under resistance.
What survives, we keep. What doesn't, we change or throw out.
KEEP IT. MODIFY IT. KILL IT.

title: True crime

description:
Welcome to True Crime Dissected, a podcast exploring real criminal cases, mysterious disappearances, unsolved crimes, and the stories behind the headlines.
We take a closer look at the evidence, investigations, key people, and unanswered questions surrounding each case. From notorious crimes to lesser-known mysteries, every episode is presented with a focus on facts, context, and thoughtful analysis.

description: The Anoeses Podcast explores kink, BDSM, intimacy, relationships, and the many ways people can explore their desires. We talk about communication, consent, boundaries, BDSM practices, and the role of self-expression in intimacy, while also taking a closer look at the products that support these experiences. Welcome to Michigistory, a poorly named but well-produced podcast where we tell the true stories of some of Michigan's most fascinating history. Join host Cassidy Hough every other Friday for new episodes.



For any story ideas, advertisement inquires, questions (or compliments), email cassidy@bigmittenmedia.com

title: The Mog Squad
author: Milo Dopp, Chase Johnson, Tucker Hicks, and Kellen Healy
description: Have you been working out and want to learn the ways of some of the best lifters of past generations? Tune into The MogSquad and learn the ways of the weights with Tucker, Milo, Kellen, and Chase. The boys will go over supplements, gym comparisons, old school vs new school, physiques, and aesthetics.

title: Two Boy Gold Miners (Adventures in the Wild West)
author: Frank V. Webster
description:
When two farm boys, Jim and Tom, decide to leave behind their struggling family farm, they embark on an adventure that takes them deep into the heart of the West. Guided by an enigmatic old prospector, the brothers face unexpected challenges that test their courage and resourcefulness. From treacherous mountain paths to desperate encounters with rival miners, their quest for gold reveals not just the thrill of discovery, but the strength of family bonds and the harsh realities of survival.

As they dig deep into the earth in search of fortune, they uncover more than just gold; they discover resilience, teamwork, and the value of persistence in the face of adversity. With each setback, their determination only grows stronger. Will they strike it rich and save their family's farm, or will their journey lead to unforeseen consequences?

Join Jim and Tom on this riveting escapade filled with suspense, excitement, and heartwarming moments. 'Two Boy Gold Miners' is not just a tale of adventure; it's a story about the risks we take for those we love and the rewards that come from daring to dream. Perfect for young listeners and families alike, this audiobook will spark curiosity and inspire courage in anyone who dares to seek their own fortune.

title: On Path with Adam Haa
author: Adam Haluska (@adamchoselife)

This is a space where we explore and update the conversation on consciousness, functional and holistic health, ancient wisdom, reality, and the future of humanity.
I’ll introduce you to people, ideas, and tools to support your journey here on earth. My hope is these conversations leave us with tools that are not just powerful, but actually usable — ones that guide us back to alignment, presence, and vitality, so we can awaken our true selves and create what we came here to CREATE.
Enjoy!

author: Trinity Church NYC
description:
If you're seeking spiritual community, examining life's big questions, or wrestling with doubt, Faith Curious from Trinity Church invites you, just as you are, to join us. Host Summerlee Staten, Executive Director of Trinity's Faith Formation and Education efforts, joins theologians, ministers, spiritual thought leaders to demystify friendship, grief, belonging, loneliness, and more through the lenses of faith and doubt. Faith Curious extends a wide welcome to all, inviting you to join other imperfect people doing our best. 
Every episode of Faith Curious blends theology and spirituality with the testimony of seekers with deep questions about who God is and about how they can grow in their faith. Faith Curious and Trinity's broader faith education efforts support listeners as they make connections between Christians beliefs and real-world problems, like loneliness and belonging, and as they bring those learnings back to their personal lives and families, and into the world at large.

description:
Singing the praises of truly great, but lesser-known, films. All the love, none of the spoilers! Classics, indies, foreign language stuff and movie gems you may have missed. Come join us. Feel the love.

title: Nobody Designed This
author: Chris Parsons
description:
Nobody Designed This is a 52-week exploration of why organisations behave as they do—and how we might build them differently. It argues that organisations are rarely designed as coherent systems; they evolve through accumulated decisions, inherited structures, shifting priorities, compromise and local adaptation. 
Across four linked themes: The Science of Organisations, The Future Executive, Designing Public Institutions and The Adaptive Organisation; the series offers concepts, models and language to help readers recognise patterns, challenge assumptions and intervene more intelligently.

title: The Bike Lawyer
author: George C. Palaidis
description:
Most of what decides a bicycle crash happens long before anyone sees a courtroom. The Bike Lawyer covers what actually keeps riders safe, what the research really says, and what the law does and does not do for you after a driver puts you on the pavement.

Hosted by George Palaidis, a Florida lawyer and cyclist who represents riders who get hit. Episodes cover passing distance laws, what to do at a crash scene, insurance and PIP after a crash, and the difference between a legal e-bike and an unregistered motorcycle. Every episode also explains what the topic means in Florida, consistently one of the most dangerous states in the country to ride a bike.

title: Strange Friends Popdcast
author: Josh Weir
description: Everyone has a story. Hear it, and you start to understand why someone is the way they are. We judge people by what we see, rarely by where they came from. Stories change that. On this podcast, you'll meet our Strange Friends and hear theirs.

title: Evergreen
author: Kamau Exom
description: Evergreen is a podcast about ideas worth carrying with you. Discipline. Transformation. Leadership. Faith. Accountability. Thinking. Responsibility. No trends to chase. No expiration date. Just ideas you can listen to on the road, on a walk, at work, or whenever you need something worth thinking about. Evergreen — ideas that don’t expire.

title: Money minnd
author: Money minnd
description: MoneyMinnd is a trusted personal finance blog helping readers across the USA and Europe make smarter financial decisions. Discover expert insights on investing, budgeting, saving, credit, loans, retirement planning, wealth building, and market trends. Our practical, easy-to-understand guides empower individuals to achieve long-term financial freedom and lasting financial success.

title: Asleep history
author: Sleep stories
description:
Asleep by Chapter Two is a calming podcast where history, myths, legends, and forgotten stories are told slowly and peacefully to help you relax and fall asleep.
Travel through ancient civilizations, medieval mysteries, timeless folklore, and fascinating historical moments—all narrated in a gentle, atmospheric style designed for quiet nights and restful minds.

author: Tristar AI

We discuss AI-powered quality inspection, automation, production monitoring, defect detection, and how manufacturers can use data to improve processes. The podcast brings practical perspectives on applying AI on the factory floor and turning production data into better decisions.

title: Knock 'Em Dead
author: Rachel Bradley and Christopher Titus
description: KNOCK 'EM DEAD is a comedy podcast that deals with the one thing we all experience, yet never talk about— death.  Co-hosts Rachel Bradley and Christopher Titus have both had up-close and personal experiences with death, and that's what propelled their desire for this podcast.  No one is prepped, prepared or taught how to deal with dying, what happens when someone dies, or how to help them along the way.  These two comedians have each turned their own experiences with death into stand-up comedy, because they both saw the absurdity in the end of life, and the wild and crazy ride it can become.  Each month, they will cover different aspects of dying, and will talk to the veterans—hospice nurses, doulas, survivors of NDEs— as well as others, who will share their own weird, wacky, insightful and moving stories about death… and, how to survive it.

title: Quality Time Podcast with Oliver Stauffer
author: Quality Time Podcast with Oliver Stauffer
description:
Quality Talks is a podcast dedicated to quality, innovation, and compliance in the pharmaceutical and life sciences industries.
Join industry experts as they discuss packaging integrity, manufacturing excellence, regulatory trends, and product quality. Each episode explores critical topics across the product lifecycle, from research and development and commercial manufacturing to product release and patient use.

title: Soulmies
author: Soulmies
description:
Soul Homies: Dylan and Aisha — best friends since Year 8 in Benin, 2011. A decade-plus and several lifetimes of growth later, they're still doing what they've always done: sharing notes on the chaotic project of becoming who you're supposed to be — now with a mic running.
Think catching up with your best friend on a long call, where "so anyway" turns into two hours, laughing about who they used to be and what it takes to become who they are.
Honest without being heavy. Funny without dodging the real stuff. Two best friends, a record button, and a conversation that never really ends.

description: From emerging voices to established heritage favourites, TRi THIS Music champions both. Welcome to TRi THIS Music: The Interviews, our brand new podcast full to the brim of artists from every generation, crossing almost every genre of music. We sit down with artists for conversations about their influences, their craft and the experiences that shaped them. Deepdiving their discographies and analysing their proudest moments as creatives and issues along the way. Discover someone new, or reconnect with an artist you love, and hear their story in their own words. Explore more at www.trithismusic.com.

title: The Narrative Drift
author: Nako Adodoadji
description: The Narrative Drift, hosted by writer, multidisciplinary artist, creative coach and story consultant Nako Adodoadji, engages honest conversations and layered stories about failure, success, identity, faith, growth, art and the creative process. Life moves fast, but here we create space to listen, learn and connect with each other in deeper ways. Along the way, we'll discover new stories, consider new paths and explore what it means to create with greater freedom and clarity, even in the midst of setbacks, waiting and the unknown.

title: Silence behind the frontlines
author: Beatrice Petrella
description:
Silence behind the frontlines is a journey through the stories and tales of those who, in Bakota Hub, continue to build a present even in times of war. The podcast follows the artists-in-residence who, through their practice, engage with the land and its memory, exploring a territory marked by history yet stubbornly alive. Their presence becomes a form of witness: a way of listening to the landscape, the people, and the quiet acts of resilience that define life on the edge of war.

A podcast by Sineglossa for the Discovery Guide project, developed in collaboration with Fundacja Ziemniaki i and Territory NGO, and co-funded by the Creative Program of the European Union.
Reported, written and narrated by Beatrice Petrella.
Edited by Alessandra Forghieri.
Story editing, sound design, original music and executive production by Jonathan Zenti. Designed and made by BAU Studio.

author: Bradley and Zach
description: Welcome to the Charm City Sideline, a podcast covering the Baltimore Ravens!   Bradley (lamarszn) and Zach (ravenshq) both have covered the Ravens on Instagram for 5+ years and decided to create a podcast in 2023.

author: BedtimeStoriesKD
description:
Welcome to The Squishy Society, the ultimate audio adventure series for kids! Have you ever wondered what happens to your favorite squishy toys when you leave the room? The toy box comes alive!

title: Children, Divorce & Family Psychology with Dr. Bill MacLaney
author: Bill
description:
Is your child struggling after divorce, refusing to see a parent, becoming anxious or angry, or getting caught in the middle of a high-conflict custody situation?


Dr. Bill MacLaney explains the psychology behind child adjustment after separation and divorce, co-parenting problems, visitation refusal, damaged parent-child relationships, loyalty conflicts, reunification therapy, and family court.


Learn why children react differently to divorce, how to recognize when they’re not adjusting well, what can make parent-child relationships deteriorate, and what actually helps families rebuild trust and connection.


New episodes weekly for divorced and separated parents who want to protect their children without blame, shame, or generic parenting advice.

title: SmileMoreDentistry with Mariliza LaCap, DDS

Washington Dental Associates – Bergenfield, NJ

Serving Bergen County & Rockland County

title: Skin AURA
author: Class Seo
description: SKIN AURA is a modern skincare and beauty podcast created for people who want to understand their skin, build better routines, and feel confident in their natural beauty.  Each episode explores the world of skincare through honest conversations, practical advice, expert insights, and real experiences. From understanding your skin type and choosing the right products to discussing common skincare concerns, ingredients, routines, lifestyle, and the latest beauty trends, SKIN AURA makes skincare easier to understand and easier to enjoy.  We believe great skin is not about chasing perfection.

title: THIS IS IRAN
author: Johnny Nash
description:
This is Iran goes beyond the headlines to explore the real Iran, it's people, history, culture, politics, controversies, and untold stories.


From Ancient Persia, the Shah and the 1979 Islamic Republic, life inside Iran, the diaspora, identity, myths and conversations other avoid, the ignorance, and the misconceptions around Iran. The myths, and the conversations otherws avoid, nothing is off limits.


Real people, real conversations. No scripts. No BS.


This is iran with Johnny Nash.

title: That is to Say

That Is to Say is a podcast about the deceptively simple words we use to describe complicated things.

One word. One guest. One big conversation. That Is to Say.

title: Rooted in the Caribbean - Women in Leadership Series
author: Domini Harewood
description:
You are invited to take this journey of exploration into what it takes to be a successful woman in leadership!
This platform was created with you in mind - to give you access to women from different walks of life and industries - who share their roots with you and how those roots have influenced their trajectory. 
An island girl at heart, it’s a pleasure to hold these conversations with phenomenal women - leaders in their field - who often happen to have Caribbean roots or associations. 
Please sit back and take this journey with us!

title: Silent Guests (Secrets of the Canadian Wilderness)
author: Arthur Edgar Forrest
description:
When Alex Morgan arrives at a secluded house in the Canadian wilderness, he’s not just seeking a getaway; he’s on a mission to uncover the truth behind his late grandfather's mysterious disappearance. As he digs deeper, he encounters the 'silent guests'—the whispers of the past that linger within the walls and the shadows of a family torn apart by secrets. Each room holds a piece of the puzzle, but the chilling echoes of betrayal and unresolved conflict threaten to unravel everything he thought he knew.

In "Silent Guests," Arthur Edgar Forrest weaves a gripping tale of suspense and intrigue, where every clue leads Alex further into a web of deception. With each revelation, he faces the haunting question: Is uncovering the truth worth the risk of unearthing buried family grudges? Listeners will find themselves immersed in a world where the wilderness is as unforgiving as the truths hidden within it. As Alex confronts the ghosts of his family’s past, he must decide whether to confront the silence or let it swallow him whole.

Join Alex on this thrilling journey filled with unexpected twists, deep emotional stakes, and the relentless pursuit of truth. Discover the dark history that binds a family together and the secrets that threaten to tear it apart. Will Alex emerge from the shadows, or will the weight of the past silence him forever?

The Auntie Chronicles is where grown-woman wisdom meets real-life stories, laughter, lessons, and a little Auntie attitude. Hosted by Barbara Howard — Thee Auntie — this is a space for honest conversations about family, relationships, money, travel, reinvention, self-care, and everything we learn while figuring life out along the way.
Some stories will make you laugh. Some might make you think. And some may sound a whole lot like your own.
Pull up a chair. There’s always room at the Auntie table.

title: Faith Beyond the Walls
author: University Presbyterian Church Seattle
description: Faith Beyond the Walls explores what Christian faith looks like beyond Sunday morning. Through real stories and conversations, we discover how faith shapes everyday life at home, at work, and in our neighborhoods and what happens when the church moves beyond its walls and into the world.

title: Builders of the World
author: Yacer Merzoug
description:
Builders of the World is a podcast for people building, investing in, and shaping the future of real estate and homebuilding.
Hosted by Yacer Merzoug, each episode features conversations with homebuilders, developers, and industry professionals about how they actually build, operate, finance, market, and sell real estate.
From sourcing land to closing deals, we explore the people, businesses, strategies, and ideas shaping the built world.

title: Redeemer Church of Castro Valley Podcast

description:
The Redeemer Church Podcast features weekly sermons from Redeemer Church in Castro Valley, California. Each week, we open the Scriptures to hear the good news of Jesus and discover how the gospel shapes the way we live, love, and follow him in everyday life.

Learn more about Redeemer Church at redeemercv.org.

title: Christ and Conversations Podcast
author: Keeton Productions
description: Christ & Conversations is a weekly Christian podcast where father-and-son duo Bert and Derrick have real, down-to-earth conversations about faith, life, and following God. Each episode explores biblical stories, Scripture, and everyday struggles to help listeners grow closer to God and strengthen their faith.

title: A Scottish Podcast the Audio Drama Series
author: Matthew McLean
description:
'A Scottish Podcast' is a serialised modern audio drama.

It chronicles the story of Lee, a washed up former radio DJ who launches a paranormal investigation podcast.

Lee wants to see his show The Terror Files mentioned up there alongside podcasts like The Black Tapes, Limetown, and The Message. And he’ll stop at nothing to achieve it. 

Aided by his jaded musician pal Dougie, the pair travel the length and breadth of the country in search of Medieval Demon Kings and Lovecraftian Gods of the Sea. 

So why not join them on this unique tour of the ancient and mystical lands of Scotland? 

You’ll walk through the long-forgotten catacombs under Edinburgh. Sail out to the lonely and abandoned island of St.Caillic. Visit dingy pubs, run-down industrial estates, and obscure non-league football grounds.  

The show contains strong language, “adult situations” (whatever that means), and isn’t for the easily offended.

title: The Matt Light Show
author: Matt Light
description: Weekly podcast hosted by Matt Light and produced by Jesse Woods

title: The Long Climb
author: Alan Rosales and John Davis
description: The Long Climb is a podcast hosted by Alan Rosales and John Davis focused on consistency, discipline, mindset, and personal growth. Through real conversations on business, fitness, leadership, habits, and life, each episode explores what it truly takes to keep showing up when motivation fades. This podcast is for anyone committed to improving themselves, building momentum, and embracing the long climb toward lasting success.

title: Provocative Politics
author: Provocative Politics
description: Provocative Politics pulls back the curtain on the hidden machinery of power, covert operations, and the stories behind official narratives. Where culture once drove the narrative, today culture itself is downstream from politics—shaped by statecraft, deep-state scandals, and digital warfare. From the legacy of intelligence agencies to modern media trends and high-level political plays, we connect the dots between historical power structures, alleged conspiracies, and today’s headlines. Uncensored, sharp, and strictly critical.

title: Euro Noir
author: Euro Noir Podcast
description: Euro Noir digs into Europe's most chilling true crime cases, the ones that never made headlines outside their own borders. Each episode is a long-form deep dive into obscure, unsolved, or wrongly-resolved cases across the continent, from Finnish forests to Spanish coastlines. Expect meticulous research, cited sources, and stories that go far beyond the Wikipedia summary. If you think you know European crime, think again.

title: Simple Marketing

Welcome to the Simple Marketing Podcast, where we talk to experts behind the growth of their successful businesses.
Tune in to the Simple Marketing Show for actionable tips to make your marketing simple and get results for your business.
Mostafa Hosseini, the host, is the founder of Persyo and the creator of three simple business growth formulas:
- Simple Marketing Formula
- Simple Retention Formula
- Simple Offer Formula
When he's not working, he loves to spend quality time with his family and friends, hit the ski slopes or hike up mountains.

title: Common Grounds — Voices of a Shared Landscape
author: Radio Grenouille
description:
COMMON GROUNDS — THE PODCAST

What happens when artists, scientists and citizens come together to explore the places they live in?

Common Grounds is a three-part podcast series following a European artistic and scientific project across France, Bulgaria and Spain.

From Marseille to Sofia and Froxán in Galicia, the series explores how artistic research, scientific knowledge and local experiences can come together to question our relationships with landscapes, communities and the living world.

Across three episodes, we meet the artists, the scientific and institutional partners, and the citizens and local initiatives involved in the project.

Through interviews, field recordings, everyday sounds and sound archives, the podcast documents a project in motion: its encounters, experiments, questions and discoveries.

Rather than telling a single story, Common Grounds brings together a plurality of voices and perspectives. From one country to another, the project evolves through collaboration, allowing knowledge and experiences to circulate between territories.

The series offers an intimate look at the people and places shaping Common Grounds, while exploring a broader question: how can art, science and collective action help us imagine new ways of inhabiting our shared environments?

Common Grounds is a European project connecting artistic research, scientific knowledge and citizen initiatives across France, Bulgaria and Spain.

A podcast co-produced by La Citadelle de Marseille and Radio Grenouille – Euphonia.

With the support and collaboration of La Citadelle de Marseille, LPED – Aix-Marseille University, Lycée Agricole des Calanques, Fundación RIA, Gradoscope, and the Daniel and Nina Carasso Foundation.

author: Meghan "Mae" McCoy
description:
Mae Out West is where music, culture, and heritage meet. Hosted by Meghan May McCoy, this podcast celebrates the artists, stories, and traditions that shape the American West and beyond. From intimate conversations with musicians to deep dives into creative legacies, each episode honors the craft and the journey. Whether you're discovering new sounds or reconnecting with timeless ones, Mae Out West is your front-row seat to the stories that matter. 
Visit maeoutwest.com for more.
Check out her weekly radio show if you love western swing and honky Tonk artist

title: Ohio Is Home
author: Ohio Immigrant Alliance
description:
Ohio is Home is a podcast from the Ohio Immigrant Alliance about migration, belonging, and the people who make Ohio what it is. We’ll talk with people from across Ohio and around the world about immigration, art, music, food, family, community, and the Ohio we’re building together.
Because migration is as natural as breathing. Because migration is human. Migration is courageous, brave, and beautiful. And Ohio is home.

author: Too Old For This Shoot

title: The Better Choice: Decoding Everyday Products for a Healthier Life
author: The Better Choice
description:
What is really inside the products you use every day?
The Better Choice investigates the biggest household brands in America, from cleaning products and personal care to kitchen essentials and everyday products found at Walmart, Target, Costco, and your local grocery store.
We look beyond the packaging to investigate ingredients, product quality, marketing claims, value, transparency, and what you are actually getting for your money.
Some products earn our recommendation.
Others belong back on the shelf.
Disclaimer: Content is based on publicly available information, product labels, manufacturer disclosures, research, and independent commentary for educational and informational purposes. Product ingredients and formulas may change over time, so always check the current label before purchasing or using a product. Rankings and recommendations reflect our evaluation criteria and should not be interpreted as medical advice or as a claim that a product is unsafe for every consumer.

title: Behind The Growth
author: The Growth Collective
description:
Behind the Growth goes beyond revenue figures, headlines and polished success stories to uncover what it genuinely takes to build something ambitious.
Hosted by Laura Donadio, each episode features honest conversations with founders, creators and business leaders about the decisions, failures, relationships and turning points behind their growth.
From the first idea and early uncertainty to scaling teams, raising money, losing control and starting again, this is the side of entrepreneurship that rarely makes the highlight reel.
New episodes bring you practical lessons, uncomfortable truths

description: Welcome to Tea Time, where we share ‘pearls of wisdom’ on all things precious! I’m your host, Carrie Lamb, Founder, Owner and Designer of FRIDA Fine Jewellery, based in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Join us as we share perspectives and stories ‘steeped’ in inspiration, meaningful moments and the things we treasure — and, of course, spill a little ‘tea’ along the way!

title: Dark Case Files | True Crime Documentary
author: Emi
description: True crime documentary stories exploring shocking murder cases, twisted family secrets, and criminal investigations that challenge everything you think you know. Each episode uncovers calculated crimes, disturbing motives, hidden evidence, and unexpected twists involving athletes, wealthy families, and seemingly perfect lives. From unsolved mysteries to cases everyone thought was closed, discover the clues, suspects, and revelations that kept detectives searching for the truth. Subscribe and listen to every compelling investigation.

title: Without Warning
author: TM
description:
Without Warning is a documentary channel about the disasters that changed
everything in an instant — in the air, at sea, on the rails, and across
the natural world. We dig into what really happened, how the warning
signs were missed, and what was left behind — always with respect for
the lives affected, never for shock value.
The disasters no one saw coming, and everything they left behind.

title: BIBLE TALK. REAL TALK
author: Leilani Benavides
description: Welcome to Bible Talk. Real Talk. Formerly P31 Fitness & Wellness, this podcast is shifting as I feel God leading me deeper into His Word. After attending the Heart Dive: Overflow Conference with my siblings, I knew I wanted to truly know God—not just check a box by reading the Bible. I'm not a pastor or Bible scholar; I'm simply growing and inviting you along. We'll walk through the Bible in an order that helps the story flow and make sense, while learning how to apply God's Word to real life. New episodes every Sunday.

author: Kelsie Grant

Uncover insights from experts, real-life anecdotes and actionable tips as we navigate the journey from burnout to breakthrough. Your path to empowerment begins here.

title: Unite the Bullpen
author: Brian Penn
description: Unite The Bullpen is an interview podcast that bridges baseball culture with real, unfiltered conversations about adversity — anxiety, PTSD, depression, suicidal thoughts, perfectionism, and addiction. The show is built for baseball fans ages 25–60 who have lived experience with these challenges and are looking for inspiration, practical guidance, and the reassurance that they’re not alone.

title: Say What?!? Good News with The Bonnie D.
author: Bonnie D. Graham
description: Are you a busy doer, thinker, innovator, leader, or change-maker? SAY WHAT?!? Good News is for YOU! Take a refreshing 5-minute break from nonstop headlines and everyday noise. Discover feel-good stories, entertainment milestones, inspiring people, fun celebrations to brighten your day and perk-up conversations with friends, family, and colleagues. Move to the music. Dance in your chair. Monday through Friday mornings. Rise and shine! Get ready to say... "SAY WHAT?!?" with The Bonnie D.! ✨

author: Sean "Seany-Doo" Williams
description: Every other Wednesday, Sean "Seany-Doo" Williams and a special guest, discuss the complicated world of dating, life situations, and the many factors that make us, "us." Here he brings together everything from his channels: Dragon Ball news, leaks and deep dives, Marvel and DC breakdowns and theories, movie reviews, and pro wrestling talk. If it is worth arguing about, it gets covered here.

title: The Questions We Carry – with Michelle Young
author: WeSeeColor
description:
Every Black woman carries questions about her skin and hair — some asked out loud, some held quietly for years. 
In each episode, Michelle Young brings her own experiences and questions together with those of women across our community, and sits down with the dermatologists, aestheticians, hairstylists, and other experts who specialize in Black skin and hair to find real answers. 
From the skin and hair conditions that affect us most to skincare, healthy hair practices, protective styles, hormonal changes, and scalp health — these are the questions we carry, answered with evidence and care.

title: The Salt Company Lincoln
author: The Salt Company UNL
description: The Salt Company is the college ministry of Citylight Lincoln Church in Lincoln, Nebraska. We exist to reach college students with the good news of the Gospel and raise them into disciple-makers. This podcast is where we post our Tuesday night sermons.

title: Beyond the Scrubs with Favour
author: Favour
description:
Behind every uniform is a human being.
Beyond the Scrubs is a space for honest conversations about the stories behind healthcare. From nursing journeys and life in Germany to failure, faith, purpose, identity, resilience and growth, we go beyond the profession to meet the person behind it.
Expect real stories, meaningful conversations and the experiences that shape the people caring for others.
Hosted by Favour.
New episodes on the 1st & 15th of every month.

title: HR Uncut
author: HR Chief Magazine
description:
People, culture, talent: easy to talk about, far harder to get right. HR Uncut, from HR Chief, finds out what it takes.
Each episode we sit down with chief people officers and global HR leaders to talk about the decisions that shape large organisations: how they attract and keep talent, what they got wrong along the way, and where the function is heading. Guests also share the career journeys and leadership philosophies behind their approach, without the corporate polish.
Tune in for lessons worth hearing. 
Discover more at www.hrchiefmagazine.com

This podcast is for you.

Dr. Dan spent 20 years in corporate America before his own undiagnosed gut nearly broke him. A naturopathic doctor found what conventional medicine missed. He recovered completely. title: F*CK! I'm 50
author: 64 Brands
description:
F*CK! I’M 50 started with a pretty simple question: where the bloody hell did the last 20 years go?


One minute you’re busy working, raising kids and dealing with life, the next you wake up and realise — Fuck! I'm 50! Our kids hardly need us anymore, yet our parents need us more than ever before.


My name's Paul Burfitt. My mates call me Burf. I’m not a guru, not a life coach and certainly not an expert. I’m just a bloke from Queensland who’s decided I’m not going to keep putting everything off.


So I’m talking to people from around Australia and other places about all the stuff that comes up at this stage of life — family, money, health, work, relationships, ambitions, regrets, fuck-ups, starting again and figuring out what makes you happy.


Some conversations will be with everyday people who have great stories. Others will be with people you already know from sport, media, business or somewhere completely unexpected. And every now and then I’ll bring in someone who genuinely knows a thing or two on the subject they’re talking.


I’ve got a podcast and a little YouTube channel set up. You’re invited to come along for the ride as I start ticking off a few things I’ve spent too many years saying I’d do “one day”.


I'm sure some people will think it's a brilliant idea. Plenty more probably won’t. But either way here we go, and remember this is a hate free zone so play nice…

There's sure to be some spills, thrills and the occasional disaster as I try to make up for a bit of lost time.


Most of all remember, F*CK! I’M 50 isn’t about having all the answers. It’s about finally asking the questions — and doing something about them.

Real life will teach you some things… but baby, sometimes the lesson comes with grief, boundaries, unanswered prayers, starting over, and a little respectfully petty truth.
The *Real Life Clarity Podcast* is a faith-rooted, honest conversation about healing, relationships, grief, self-worth, confidence, dating, purpose, boundaries, and becoming the woman God is calling you to be—without pretending the journey is always pretty.
Hosted by *Dorlita Blakely* , each episode brings real-life reflection, practical wisdom, biblical truth, grown-woman perspective, and the occasional holy-and-hood reality check. Because sometimes you need encouragement…and sometimes you need somebody to lovingly tell you, “Baby, that is not peace. That is a pattern.”
This is a space for women who have survived some things, learned some things, lost some things, rebuilt some things—and still believe there is more life to live.
No perfect-life performances. No empty motivation. No pretending faith means you never get tired, disappointed, confused, or fed up.
Just real life. Real faith. Real healing. Real growth. And the clarity to know what deserves your grace, what requires a boundary, and what you need to leave right where it is.
*Real Life Clarity Podcast — because healing is holy, clarity changes everything, and sometimes the breakthrough starts when you finally tell yourself the truth.*

How does the friction of life shape an artist, and what does their art reveal about all of us?

On Harry Gots Friends, I sit down with painters, graffiti writers, costume designers, wig makers, musicians, stage managers, pizza makers and other working creatives. We dig into their life stories: the people, setbacks, day jobs, detours and hard turns that pushed back on them and made them who they are.

title: The America Experiment
author: Tim Elliott
description:
Over the 20+ decades since the Constitution of the United States was signed, America has endured many challenges, including 9 wars, and come out of all of it stronger and better.  Today, America is the most diverse, the strongest, most powerful, most prosperous, yet most generous nation on Earth …and the envy of the rest of the world. The reason? The first 10 Amendments to the Constitution, known as the Bill Of Rights, specifically the first two. The 1st Amendment protects the right to speak one’s mind publicly, and to peaceably assemble in protest. The second protects the first by giving every citizen the right to keep and bear arms.

The sole purpose of this podcast is to be a resource for understanding the important issues and events of today, as the Grand Experiment known as America continues.

title: Oh, For The Love Of...: A Green Acres Tribute Podcast
author: Paul & Rick
description:
“Oh, for the Love of…?” is a Green Acres retrospective hosted by Paul and Rick, two longtime fans heading back to Hooterville to revisit one of television’s funniest—and strangest—classic sitcoms.

Join us as we follow Oliver and Lisa Douglas, Mr. Haney, Eb, the Ziffels, Arnold the Pig and the rest of the wonderfully eccentric residents of Hooterville. We’ll revisit the episodes one at a time, sharing favorite moments, behind-the-scenes stories, trivia, personal memories, and plenty of laughs along the way.

Green Acres was much more than a show about a New York lawyer who traded Manhattan for a broken-down farm. It was wonderfully absurd television that frequently seemed to know it was a television show—and wasn't afraid to let the audience in on the joke.

“Oh, for the Love of…?” is part of the Aunt Ro Was Right family of podcasts—celebrating the classic television shows Paul grew up watching, despite his Aunt Ro repeatedly warning his mother:

Accessibility for Humans — approachable tips and training for understanding accessibility requirements, identifying common barriers, and building better practices into your organization’s work.

Whether you’re a nonprofit leader, communicator, program professional, content editor, or website administrator, No Stress Web Success gives you the clarity and coaching to care for your website with confidence.

title: The Prosecution Playbook: What the Court Record Reveals
author: Mary
description:
The Prosecution Playbook examines what happens when the power of prosecution goes unchecked. This is not a traditional true-crime podcast. The Prosecution Playbook examines criminal cases through transcripts, court filings, judicial orders, and other public records to reveal how prosecutorial decisions affect real lives.

Each episode uses court transcripts, indictments, motions, judicial orders, sentencing records, appellate decisions, and other publicly available documents to reconstruct a criminal case. We examine the original charges, the prosecution’s disputed tactics, the outcome, and the defendant’s efforts to obtain post-conviction relief.

The conversations you hear are narrated or reconstructed using artificial voices for clarity and storytelling. They are not the actual voices of the defendants, prosecutors, attorneys, judges, witnesses, or other people involved. Reconstructed dialogue is based on, summarized from, or clearly distinguished from the underlying court record.

This podcast provides commentary and analysis for educational and public-interest purposes. Allegations are identified as allegations, disputed matters are presented as disputed, and listeners are encouraged to examine the court documents and reach their own conclusions.

At the end of each case, one question remains: Did the justice system deliver justice—or simply follow the prosecution’s playbook?

This podcast is not legal advice.


Episodes are based on publicly available court records or published articles .  Often the defendant has not be interviewed for the podcast. The voices are AI-generated narrations and are not the actual voices of anyone involved in the case. Some statements have been summarized or reconstructed for clarity; direct quotations are identified as such.

description:
Real conversations about faith, leadership, and building something that lasts.
Hosted by Anto Boutros — entrepreneur, investor, and founder of Reborn Homes in Indianapolis — the Reborn Podcast features long-form conversations with leaders, entrepreneurs, and people of faith who are building businesses and lives rooted in purpose.
Topics include faith and business, leadership, entrepreneurship, overcoming adversity, private money lending, and what it really takes to build something meaningful.
New episodes weekly. No fluff. No scripts. Just honest stories.
Connect: tony@indyhomesreborn.com

title: Leave the 99
author: Russell Van Maele
description: Welcome to Leave the 99, the show hosted by Dr. Russell Van Maele, dedicated to helping you fulfill your God-given purpose through amazing, optimized health. We cut through the noise of the modern wellness space to bring you a white-glove, concierge-level approach to medicine. From the latest in peptides and premium supplements to intentional, daily habits that honor your mind, body, and spirit, we give you the tools to simplify your health. Join us to find your purpose, build a deeper relationship with your Creator, and take control of your well-being with a doctor who truly understands what drives you.

title: GI Junction
author: Doc Schmidt LLC
description: Hosted by Doc Schmidt and Dr. Dimitroff — two board-certified gastroenterologists with 4 decades of combined experience between them — GI Junction delivers real, evidence-based answers to the GI questions everyone has but rarely asks. Every episode covers a topic straight from the clinic: colon cancer screening, IBS, liver health, bloating, acid reflux, gut health trends, and everything in between.
